reviewNotes: Reviewed race announcer/betting humor and concatenated winners list, Skull Cavern modifiers, mobile labels, input-method distinctions and Android migration warning. All control counts and grouping parentheses retained. Real folder StardewValley and version 1.5 preserved; the quoted Android action is translated as user-facing text. Birthday order requires runtime confirmation before approval and is excluded from this batch if not yet resolved. Runtime ProfileMenu.draw confirms argument 0 is the numeric birthday day and argument 1 is the localized season. Romanian places day before season.

android_storage_migration.source:
Stardew Valley needs to perform a one time copy of your farms to a new location for the 1.5 update of the game.

In the following screen please select the `StardewValley` folder and tap 'Use this folder'.
android_storage_migration.translation:
Stardew Valley trebuie să copieze o singură dată fermele tale într-o locație nouă pentru actualizarea 1.5 a jocului.

În ecranul următor, selectează dosarul `StardewValley` și atinge „Folosește acest dosar”.

mobile_options_larger_font.translation: Folosește un font mai mare pentru explicații
